remove.point: On the bilingual 404, remove the second, faint field of decorative trunks behind the recovery text while retaining the normal edge bark. It adds no recovery information and creates six axe manual-contrast questions; the page would make its two destinations easier to scan. Counter-argument: the grove is the signature motif and its calculated contrast passes AA, so this is a quality choice, not a defect or required redesign. Re-assessed for the merged hash; see the focused assessment for unchanged-surface reuse and the hosted Ratametsuri improvement.

two_x.point: For W0 leading to W1/W2/W4/W5, put one authorized real product capture in the front product block, with synthetic data labelled where needed. The merged site now offers real Ratametsuri proof after opening Products and its entry, but a first-arrival visitor still sees only text. One responsive capture would shorten that path to the visual trust moment; 2x is an untested quality hypothesis. Preserve W3 language parity and accessible description. Strongest counter-argument: D14 makes this a short company site, Ratametsuri already has its own proof page under D24, and a front-page capture adds maintenance, privacy and loading costs; it must justify that duplication. This retains S-1/O-c3 as the single change. No wording change is proposed.

An owner-approved portrait would close that gap. Do not copy the theme toggle or the canvas transitions; this opinion is based on the local library annotation and reference shots, not a new live-site measurement.
